_doc: P280: the Agent's own words after a state change (zh/en). {title} = owner.address (empty → default below). A list rotates; an object picks by time of day. Limits are checked by tests/test_p280_humane.py on the text with {title} at its default and every other placeholder removed.

morning: {title}，又是美好的一天，今天我们做点啥？
{title}，早上好！新对话开好了，今天先办哪件？
afternoon: {title}，新对话开好了，下午咱们做点啥？
{title}，又是美好的一天，接下来我们做点啥？
evening: {title}，晚上好，新对话开好了，想做点什么？
{title}，翻开新一页，晚上咱们做点啥？
night: {title}，夜深了，新对话备好了，有事尽管吩咐。
{title}，新对话开好了，夜里也随时听您吩咐。

morning: Another lovely day, {title}. What shall we do today?
afternoon: Fresh conversation, {title}. What shall we do this afternoon?
evening: Evening, {title}. Fresh conversation — what would you like to do?
New page, {title}. What shall we do tonight?
night: It's late, {title}. A fresh conversation is ready whenever you are.
Clean slate, {title}. I'm here if you need anything tonight.

clear.kept.zh: 上一段对话我替您收好了，发新消息之前都能撤销。
clear.kept.en: I've put the last conversation away — you can undo until you send a new message.

clear.noop.zh: 本来就是新对话，不用清空，直接说吧。
clear.noop.en: This is already a fresh conversation — just go ahead.

clear.phone_only.zh: 清空要在手机上确认：点输入框左边的 ≡「全部命令」→「开新对话」。
clear.phone_only.en: Confirm the clear on the phone: ≡ next to the input → All commands → New conversation.

undo.done.zh: 好，接回刚才那段对话了，咱们接着聊。
undo.done.en: Done — we're back in the earlier conversation. Let's carry on.

undo.late.zh: 来不及撤销了：新对话已经开始，旧对话存在这台电脑上。
undo.late.en: Too late to undo: the new conversation has started. The old one is saved on this computer.

compact.done.zh: 压缩好了，脑子清爽了，咱们接着聊。
compact.done.en: Compacted — clear head, let's carry on.

compact.progress.en: Writing my handover first, then compacting…

compact.handover_fail.zh: 交接没来得及写，已经直接压缩了。
compact.handover_fail.en: I couldn't write the handover first; compacted anyway.

recover.compact.zh: 压缩好了，我在翻交接笔记，马上接上思路。
recover.compact.en: Compacted. I'm reading my handover notes to pick up the thread.

recover.clear.zh: 清空好了，我在读交接笔记，一会儿就接上。
recover.clear.en: Cleared. I'm reading my handover notes and will pick up shortly.

cmd.after_turn.zh: 收到，等这一轮忙完就办。
cmd.after_turn.en: Got it — I'll do it when this turn finishes.

shared.wait_idle.zh: 等电脑这一轮忙完，我马上执行。
shared.wait_idle.en: I'll run it as soon as the computer's current turn finishes.

shared.busy_queued.zh: 电脑正忙，消息我先排上，忙完马上接。
shared.busy_queued.en: The computer is busy — your message is queued; I'll pick it up right after.

shared.merged.zh: 这条和下一条回复一起回您。
shared.merged.en: I'll answer this together with the next reply.

shared.reattached.en: Back on track — attached to the new session {sid}.

shared.empty_turn.zh: 这一轮结束了，不过 Claude 没留文字回复。
shared.empty_turn.en: That turn ended, but Claude didn't leave a text reply.

shared.model_ok.zh: 换好了（电脑状态栏已确认，仅本会话）：{reading}
shared.model_ok.en: Switched (confirmed by the desktop status line, this session only): {reading}

shared.model_queued.zh: 收到，电脑这一轮忙完就换，以状态栏为准。
shared.model_queued.en: Got it — I'll switch when the desktop turn ends; the status line has the final word.

shared.model_unconfirmed.zh: 模型/思考强度没换成（{why}），以电脑上的实际读数为准。
shared.model_unconfirmed.en: The model/effort switch didn't go through ({why}); the pill shows the desktop's actual reading.

codex.waiting.zh: 电脑上的 Codex 正在回答，等它说完我就把您的消息递过去。
codex.waiting.en: The desktop Codex is mid-answer; I'll hand over your message when it finishes.

model.switched_now.zh: 换好了，现在用 {model}，重启后也一样。
model.switched_now.en: Switched to {model} — effective now, and it sticks after restarts.

model.switched_next.zh: 换好了，下一条消息起用 {model}。
model.switched_next.en: Switched — {model} from your next message on.

stop.done.zh: 好，停下了{what}。别的都没暂停，随时接着说。
stop.done.en: Stopped {what}. Nothing else is paused — carry on whenever you like.

stop.what_both.zh: 这一轮和正在跑的定时任务
stop.what_both.en: this turn and the running scheduled task

stop.none.zh: 现在没有在跑的一轮，不用停。

update.started.zh: 我去升级了，服务会重启一下，回来就告诉您结果。
update.started.en: Upgrading now — the service will restart; I'll report back when I'm up.

update.current.zh: 已经是最新的 {to}，不用升级。

update.auto_ok_default.zh: 装上了最新正式版的改进

update.auto_rollback.zh: {title}，夜里升级没成功，已回滚到 {from}，原因：{reason}。
update.auto_rollback.en: {title}, last night's update failed; I rolled back to {from} ({reason}).
